datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Somalia to collect Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data. Geographic boundaries were classified into IPC phases representing acute food insecurity severity levels, with multiple scenarios projected for near-term forecasting. Data were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) with classification metadata for 2019.
